_meta.description: NDA membership used for bloc swing, by state and election. Only parties that contested as part of the NDA seat-sharing arrangement are listed; NDA members that fought against the BJP in that election are excluded. Values are party abbreviations from data/parties.json.
notes: UP 2024: NISHAD's candidate contested on the BJP symbol, so those votes are already counted as BJP.
Punjab: the SAD left the NDA in 2020; in 2024 the BJP contested alone.
Manipur 2022: NPP and NPF were NDA members but contested against the BJP, so only the BJP is counted. In 2024 the BJP backed the NPF candidate in Outer Manipur.
